$comment: Web UI performance budgets (ADR 151; two JS budgets and the re-baseline ritual per ADR 183). Enforced by `pnpm perf:check` against packages/web/dist/client after a build. initialJsGzipBytes is the worst route's eager graph — what a viewer downloads before the page is interactive, and the number lazy-loading moves. totalJsGzipBytes is every chunk including lazy ones — how much code the product carries, which lazy-loading cannot reduce. Raising a number is a deliberate, reviewed act: justify it in the PR and log the measured cost in docs/perf/web-live-baseline.md. Re-baselined 2026-07-29 from main @ 0acb669 to measured + 15% headroom (initial 124.1 KB on /asks-preview, total 201.7 KB over 29 chunks, largest chunk 98.1 KB, CSS 19.1 KB, fonts 554.5 KB); maxChunkGzipBytes kept its 2026-07-19 value because measured + 15% would have LOOSENED it, and a re-baseline may only tighten (ADR 183).
